Outlet: Al Jazeera (liveblog), published 8 Nov 2026 (fetched ~07:55 GMT; WebFetch returned only the summary head of the liveblog)

Headline: Iran war live: US moves to block land supply routes; UAE rescues 22 sailors
Authors: Fiona Kelliher, Caolán Magee, and Chris Hamill-Stewart

Key Developments:
1. UAE Rescue Operation: The United Arab Emirates rescued 22 people from a cargo vessel that caught fire after Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps stated that "two oil tankers had struck mines in the Strait of Hormuz."
2. US Blockade Expansion: The United States announced a strategy to "block Iran's land-based supply routes," building upon its existing months-long naval blockade of Iranian ports in the Strait of Hormuz.

Additional Context:
Iranian state media reported explosions on Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz and in the cities of Jask, Sirik, and Bandar Abbas. The coverage includes a video segment titled "CENTCOM forms task force to disrupt Iran's land supply routes" (8 minutes 57 seconds), showing damage to a St. Kitts-flagged cargo vessel following what US Central Command characterized as a strike intended to disable the vessel for attempting to breach the US blockade.
